issue.title: S18 · A reload is the same device coming back
issue.body:
**PRD ID:** S18 · **Threat IDs:** T-I8
### Summary
Today a reload makes a new device: joins break and transfers start over.
### Acceptance (Given / When / Then)
Given a joined device halfway through a transfer, when its page reloads, then it comes back with the same id, name and colour, still joined. The transfer finishes. Edge: received files stay in memory only, so the transfer restarts from a holder. A duplicated tab can't get the Web Lock on its tab id and starts as a new device. After a tab closes, the next start-up deletes its stored keys (ARCHITECTURE.md 6.1).
